description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusAPI class, which exposes REST API endpoints for managing employment status entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employment statuses, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employment statuses, providing CRUD operations with validation and documentation.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmploymentStatusService used by this API.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Employment Status by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all Employment Statuses with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Employment Status identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Employment Statuses based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Sets the name on an EmploymentStatus entity and saves it via the service.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single Employment Status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing Employment Statuses.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating an Employment Status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating an Employment Status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting Employment Statuses.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including uniqueness and length constraints.
